summary: Lets a server resource answer HTTP requests, for a website, launcher backend or bot. The server listens only if its owner sets KCDS_HTTP_PORT, and KCDS_HTTP_BIND picks the interface, 0.0.0.0 by default. Limits are 1 MiB of body, 10 s to answer, 64 routes per resource, and a request rate per address, with 429 above it. A resource's routes end when it stops. The same listener serves the server's own GET /info.json, /dynamic.json and /players.json first (see Running a server).

route.summary: Serves `<method> /<resource><path>` with a handler that runs as the resource's own code. Returns a function that removes the route.

params.method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS.
params.path: The path under the resource's prefix.
params.handler: Receives { method, path, query, headers, body }, with the body as text. Returns or resolves to { status, headers, body }. A body that is neither a string nor a Buffer is sent as JSON.

enabled.summary: Whether the server is listening for HTTP, which the server owner decides.
enabled.exampleLua:
if not kcds.core.Http.enabled then
  print("set KCDS_HTTP_PORT to serve the shop API")
end
